# Payment Security & Webhook Integrity Checklist: Wompi Plan Purchase

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, completeness, clarity, and consistency of security, webhook integrity, and idempotency requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are cryptographic hash algorithms and parameter concatenation orders explicitly documented for checkout integrity signatures? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §Assumptions, research.md §1]
- [x] CHK002 Are required webhook payload fields and signature verification mechanisms fully specified for incoming transaction events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012, research.md §2]
- [x] CHK003 Are transaction amount and currency validation rules explicitly documented to prevent tampering or underpayment? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, User Story 3 Scenario 3]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements documented for handling and rejecting malformed or unverifiable webhook payloads? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-012, User Story 3 Scenario 2]
- [x] CHK005 Are audit logging requirements specified for all security-sensitive events, signature failures, and amount discrepancies? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022, §Key Entities]

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Non-Ambiguity

- [x] CHK006 Is the SHA-256 concatenation formula for Wompi checkout integrity signatures unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §Assumptions, research.md §1]
- [x] CHK007 Is the idempotency key / event identifier explicitly specified for deduplicating repeated webhook deliveries? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §Key Entities, data-model.md §1.3]
- [x] CHK008 Is the term "immediate" for webhook acknowledgement quantified with a specific maximum latency threshold? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004 (<1.5s)]
- [x] CHK009 Are specific rejection codes and failure diagnostics from the payment gateway defined or mapped to user-facing diagnostic text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, User Story 5 Scenario 1]
- [x] CHK010 Is the definition of "duplicate client transaction" quantified with explicit matching criteria (e.g., user ID, plan type, timestamp window)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, User Story 7 Scenarios 2 & 3]

## 3. Requirement Consistency & Conflict Avoidance

- [x] CHK011 Do duplicate transaction requirements consistently dictate rejection (`Rejected_Duplicate`) across User Story 7, Edge Cases, and FR-025 without contradicting single-payment assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 7, §FR-025, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK012 Are payment reference lifecycle requirements consistent in ensuring failed, cancelled, or rejected references are permanently archived and never reused? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-019, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK013 Do currency specifications consistently mandate Colombian Pesos (`COP`) across checkout, webhook verification, and pricing definitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-008, §FR-013, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK014 Are the requirements for in-flight pending payments consistent between webhook resolution and client-side return polling? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017, User Story 4 Scenarios 1 & 2]

## 4. Edge Cases & Exception Coverage

- [x] CHK015 Does the spec explicitly define system behavior and state transitions when a webhook reports an amount or currency mismatch? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-013, User Story 3 Scenario 3]
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements documented for gateway webhook delivery retries to guarantee idempotent processing without duplicate activations? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014, §SC-006, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are concurrent checkout initiation scenarios across multiple browser tabs addressed with explicit collision prevention requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §User Story 7, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements specified for secret key rotation and environment isolation between Wompi Sandbox and Production? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, research.md §6]
- [x] CHK019 Does the spec define recovery requirements when a user session expires or is terminated while a payment transaction is in-flight? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## 5. Non-Functional Security & Measurability

- [x] CHK020 Can the 100% rejection rate for invalid webhook signatures or mismatched amounts be objectively verified via automated security testing? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK021 Can the 0% duplicate plan activation rate under identical webhook replay be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK022 Are server-side secret credential isolation requirements documented to guarantee private keys and integrity secrets never leak to client bundles? [Security, Spec §Assumptions, research.md §6]

---

## Notes

- **Review Evaluation (2026-09-12)**: PASSED across all 22 criteria.
- **Evaluation Details**:
  - All cryptographic algorithms (SHA-256) and concatenation parameters for both checkout signatures and webhook event checksums are mathematically defined.
  - Replay attacks and gateway retries are defended via atomic event tracking (`payment_webhook_events.event_id`).
  - Strict duplicate payment prevention policies reject concurrent transactions with status `Rejected_Duplicate` and queue them for audit/refund.
  - Server-side environment isolation guarantees private credentials never leak into client bundles.
  - All 22 requirements quality criteria are satisfied; feature is ready for `/speckit-implement`.
